summary: Wooden 25-ft tower on Helena's hill; sources give 1869, 1874 or 1876 for the build. Arson in 2016, restored by the city in 2025, listed as standing.

facts.design: Wooden tower with an octagonal cab added in 1886

staffing.note: Last used as a lookout in 1931 (NHLR, firelookout.com); no source gives later staffing

access.note: City-administered landmark in Fire Tower Park. No source says whether visitors may climb the tower or its cab.

events.note: First fire tower on the hill, per Historic Montana. Helena History places the first watchtower in the early 1870s. Fire later destroyed it (Historic Montana)
The tower described by Helena History, Historic Montana and MFP as built in 1874. NHLR and Wikidata say 1876; the firelookout.com page says 1869
City added a guardroom and bell (Historic Montana) and an octagonal cab (firelookout.com). A larger 2,121-lb bell needed the tower reinforced (Helena History)
Electric Gamewell alarm system installed; the tower bell was left mostly for tolling the juvenile curfew
1935 earthquakes damaged the tower; the 1886 bell was taken down and displayed in front of the A-A Garage until 1939. The firelookout.com page dates the earthquake damage to 1936
Lightning-caused fire weakened the structure; both bells removed. firelookout.com says it was repaired
Arson fire damaged the tower in August 2016
In February 2017 the city announced plans to remove and reconstruct the tower (Helena History); firelookout.com says demolish and replace with a similar structure. Public outcry; not torn down
Friends of the Fire Tower nonprofit formed to restore and preserve the tower
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register as US 1475, MT 69

Restoration by Dick Anderson Construction. MFP (dated April 7, 2025) says work began in January and was expected by the end of May; KRTV says it was completed in May and rededicated. Year taken from the MFP date and the May finish

corrections.why: Wikidata's 1876 is repeated by NHLR, but Helena History (which links a construction contract), Historic Montana and MFP all date the standing tower to 1874. The record should show the disagreement rather than 1876 alone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1874 (Helena History, Historic Montana, MFP) vs 1876 (NHLR, Wikidata) vs 1869 (firelookout.com) for the tower that stands. Earlier first tower 1868 (Historic Montana) or early 1870s (Helena History). Not settled by any source.
Restoration contract: $424,383 (MFP) vs bid award of nearly $386,000 (KRTV). Start: January (MFP) vs December (KRTV)
Historic Montana says the tower served nearly seventy years; NHLR and firelookout.com give 1931 as the last year of lookout use

notes_for_editor: Build year is disputed (1874, 1876, 1869; first tower 1868 or early 1870s); the correction proposes 1874 but a human should confirm, perhaps against the Helena History construction-contract PDF, which was linked but not read. Restoration year 2025 is inferred from the April 2025 MFP date and the May finish; the KRTV page as read has no date. Restoration cost and start date conflict between MFP and KRTV. Status is standing per the Montana list. Access is inferred from city administration and the park location; no source says whether the cab is open to climbing. Research budget: about ten page reads for this tower against a six-read brief, several spent on pages that gave nothing usable (a Visit Montana page, the city project page).
